method_fit.label: Capital cycle and normalized industry economics
failure_modes: replacement cost used for assets that cannot earn their cost of capital

validation_cohort.purpose: Test depletion, commodity exposure, finite reserves, and royalty-unit reconciliation.
Test tangible capital, credit losses, funding, regulation, and excess-capital realization.
Test owner earnings, capital-light reinvestment, cyclicality, and buyback value creation.
Test normalized margins, industry supply response, replacement cost, and reinvestment timing.
Test product concentration, pipeline probabilities, patent cliffs, and catalyst timing.

method_fit.rule: Power Zones select the fitting economic method and eligible independent reviewers; they never choose the valuation answer or capital decision.

outcomes.weighting_rule: Do not change a persona's relevance within a power zone until at least 20 attributable, dividend-aware outcomes exist there; never reweight automatically.

attribution.explanation: The current component schedule is the first decision-grade baseline; attribution begins with the next dated valuation snapshot.

component_valuation.decision_rule: Use the complete low/base/high component schedule. Embedded components are estimated but not added twice. Security equity value per share is floored at 0 (limited liability).

economic_claim.enterprise_to_equity_reconciliation: Each milestone is a separate dated payoff with a unique overlap key; collection/spend-cap reserve is not a second haircut on the same milestone cash.

valuation_proof.economic_claim: Risked PV of $17.50/$8.75 net-sales CVR tranche
valuation_proof.evidence: Primary from ABMD.CVR/investor-documents/sec/JNJ_CVR_Agreement_EX-10.1.htm and cvr_terms.json; component schedule reconciled 2026-07-25 contract backfill.
valuation_proof.adjustment: Fallback window reduces payout; not double-counted with other milestones.
valuation_proof.falsifier: Milestone missed, agreement amendment, or J&J spend-cap exhaustion zeros the claim.

risk_and_timing.timing_basis: Primary measurement JNJ FY Q2 2027–Q1 2028; fallback through FY Q1 2029 per cvr_terms.json.
risk_and_timing.probability_basis: Base ~35% chance of primary/fallback sales payout through FY2029; low near-miss, high primary $17.50.
risk_and_timing.remaining_capital_basis: Holder cost is zero; J&J spend-cap is issuer-side (not holder capital).

valuation_proof.economic_claim: Risked PV of $7.50 FDA STEMI approval tranche
valuation_proof.evidence: Primary from ABMD.CVR/investor-documents/sec/JNJ_CVR_Agreement_EX-10.1.htm and cvr_terms.json; component schedule reconciled 2026-07-25 contract backfill.
valuation_proof.falsifier: Milestone missed, agreement amendment, or J&J spend-cap exhaustion zeros the claim.

risk_and_timing.probability_basis: Regulatory base rate under spend-cap efforts; base ~33% risked PV vs $7.50 face.
risk_and_timing.remaining_capital_basis: No remaining holder capital; milestone cash only if FDA path succeeds.

valuation_proof.economic_claim: Risked PV of $10.00 clinical recommendation tranche
valuation_proof.evidence: Primary from ABMD.CVR/investor-documents/sec/JNJ_CVR_Agreement_EX-10.1.htm and cvr_terms.json; component schedule reconciled 2026-07-25 contract backfill.
valuation_proof.adjustment: Payable on earliest of named STEMI DTU / PROTECT IV / RECOVER IV paths.
valuation_proof.falsifier: Milestone missed, agreement amendment, or J&J spend-cap exhaustion zeros the claim.

risk_and_timing.timing_basis: Class I guideline deadline 2029-12-31; also capped four years after study publication.
risk_and_timing.probability_basis: Base assumes partial path success among named studies before deadline.
risk_and_timing.remaining_capital_basis: No remaining holder capital; payment contingent on guideline language.

valuation_proof.economic_claim: Friction from non-tradeable inventory, spend-cap efforts, payment lag
valuation_proof.evidence: Primary from ABMD.CVR/investor-documents/sec/JNJ_CVR_Agreement_EX-10.1.htm and cvr_terms.json; component schedule reconciled 2026-07-25 contract backfill.
valuation_proof.adjustment: Does not re-zero individual milestone probabilities.
valuation_proof.falsifier: Milestone missed, agreement amendment, or J&J spend-cap exhaustion zeros the claim.

valuation_decision.primary_power_zone: Capital cycle and normalized industry economics
valuation_decision.next_action: Freeze the evidence packet and select three method-independent raters.
